notes: List prices only. Claude Code transcripts have carried no costUSD since 1.0.9, so every dollar figure here is a local estimate, not a bill.
On subscription plans (Pro/Max/Team) the dollar total is not what is billed; use it as a relative routing metric.

Every figure, cache writes included, is the pricing page's own (Model pricing table and Prompt caching multipliers), fetched 2026-10-02 and in agreement with the claude-api skill's model table (cached 2026-09-25). Cache writes are 1.25x (5m) and 2x (1h) input; cache reads are 0.05x input on Opus 5.5, 0.025x on Fable 5.1 and 0.1x elsewhere, so they are stored as dollars, never derived.
claude-fable-5 is its own entry: its cache read is $1, not Fable 5.1's $0.25.
claude-opus-4-7 and claude-opus-4-8 alias to claude-opus-5: the page lists identical prices for them.
Opus 5 fast mode ($10 input / $50 output) is not modelled; records are priced at the standard tier.
Batch API discount (50%) is not modelled.
cache_write_1h is used when the usage block splits cache creation into ephemeral_1h_input_tokens; otherwise cache creation is priced at the 5m rate.

A model id with no entry or alias here is reported as unknown (a warning and its own unknown: row) and priced at default_model so the total is not silently short; add the model here rather than aliasing it to a different-priced one.
